recap.description: Two or three short sentences to the user (≤300 chars): what is now true or changed, then where it stands, including what is not done or not verified. Its first sentence is the sidebar status. It must stand on its own, since it is also read away from the transcript and the box draws under anything you write after this call: never point at anything else in the conversation ("listed below", "see above", "in my message").

ask.description: The one question (≤100 chars) when the next move is the user's call — a choice, a go-ahead (to act here on what this turn found, say), an approval: the decision alone, with no reason or recommendation and without listing the options the buttons give (actions[0] is your pick). Like the recap, never point at anything else in the conversation. Omit it, and actions, when nothing waits on the user.

blocked.description: true when your work stops here until the user answers (the app marks the session as waiting on them); omit when the answer can wait.

action.description: An app action update_plan's result listed as available now, or one your own work this turn made available; anything else is refused, and one that stops being available later is dropped (as actions[0], with your ask and the other answers), so do not guess. Omit for a reply.

label.description: For a reply: the button text, 1–3 words (4 only when three cannot say it) / 24 characters — "Yes, fix 1", "Fix 2 instead", "Not now": a button, not a sentence; the detail goes in message. No leading / or !. Ignored for an app action (the app's own label is used).

message.description: For a reply: what the click sends, up to 300 characters of plain text — no leading / or !. Omit when the label is the whole message.

actions.description: 1–2 buttons, recommendation first. They are answers to your ask: the first accepts your recommendation, and another is there only when it is a realistic alternative the user might pick instead — not a menu of everything you mentioned. When blocked is true, they are the most likely answers to your question. While Auto-fix is on for the session's PR, none offers to watch it, fix CI, resolve conflicts or address comments.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__browser_batch
tools.description: Execute a sequence of Browser pane tool calls in ONE round trip. Each item is {name, input} where input is exactly what you'd pass to that tool standalone. Actions execute SEQUENTIALLY (not in parallel) and stop on the first error. Use this tool extensively to quickly execute work whenever you can predict two or more steps ahead — e.g. navigate, click a field, type, press Return, screenshot. Each tool's own permission check runs per item — a step on a site the user hasn't allowed either asks the user inline (and continues if they allow) or is refused, which stops the batch; if a step is refused for a missing permission, call that tool on its own (that call can ask the user), then batch the rest. Screenshots and other images are returned interleaved with outputs; coordinates you write in THIS batch refer to the screenshot taken BEFORE this call. browser_batch cannot be nested, and preview_start is not batchable — but if the Browser pane isn't open yet, a batch whose FIRST action is navigate with a url opens it (other actions still need an open page).

For computer items whose action is left_click, right_click, double_click, triple_click, left_click_drag, key or type, and for form_input items, include action_summary in the item's input, as you would when calling that tool directly.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
tools.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

schema.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
schema.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

tabId.description: Tab to act on within the preview context. Omit for the fronted tab; get ids from tabs_context.

action.description:
The action to perform:
* `left_click`: Click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `right_click`: Click the right mouse button at the specified coordinates to open context menus.
* `double_click`: Double-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `triple_click`: Triple-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `type`: Type a string of text.
* `screenshot`: Take a screenshot of the screen.
* `wait`: Wait for a specified number of seconds.
* `scroll`: Scroll up, down, left, or right at the specified coordinates.
* `key`: Press a specific keyboard key.
* `left_click_drag`: Drag from start_coordinate to coordinate.
* `zoom`: Take a screenshot of a specific region for closer inspection.
* `scroll_to`: Scroll an element into view using its element reference ID from read_page or find tools.
* `hover`: Move the mouse cursor to the specified coordinates or element without clicking. Useful for revealing tooltips, dropdown menus, or triggering hover states.

coordinate.description: (x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates. Required for `left_click`, `right_click`, `double_click`, `triple_click`, and `scroll`. For `left_click_drag`, this is the end position.

text.description: The text to type (for `type` action) or the key(s) to press (for `key` action). For `key` action: Provide space-separated keys (e.g., "Backspace Backspace Delete"). Supports keyboard shortcuts using the platform's modifier key (use "cmd" on Mac, "ctrl" on Windows/Linux, e.g., "cmd+a" or "ctrl+a" for select all). Page zoom shortcuts (e.g. "cmd+=", "ctrl+-", "cmd+0") are not supported - use the `zoom` action to magnify a region of the page instead.

duration.description: The number of seconds to wait. Required for `wait`. Maximum 10 seconds.

scroll_direction.description: The direction to scroll. Required for `scroll`.

scroll_amount.description: The number of scroll wheel ticks. Optional for `scroll`, defaults to 3.

region.description: (x0, y0, x1, y1): The rectangular region to capture for `zoom`. Coordinates define a rectangle from top-left (x0, y0) to bottom-right (x1, y1) in pixels from the viewport origin. Required for `zoom` action. Useful for inspecting small UI elements like icons, buttons, or text.

scale.description: For `screenshot` and `zoom` only. Scale factor in [0.1, 1] for the returned image; 1 (default) uses the full image token budget, 0.5 returns an image at half the width and height (~quarter of the tokens). Coordinates are ALWAYS in the full-resolution coordinate frame (reported with every scaled screenshot), never in the scaled image's own pixels.

repeat.description: Number of times to repeat the key sequence. Only applicable for `key` action. Must be a positive integer between 1 and 100. Default is 1. Useful for navigation tasks like pressing arrow keys multiple times.

ref.description: Element reference ID from read_page or find tools (e.g., "ref_1", "ref_2"). Required for `scroll_to` action. Can be used as alternative to `coordinate` for click actions.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys for click actions. Supports: "ctrl", "shift", "alt", "cmd" (or "meta"), "win" (or "windows"). Can be combined with "+" (e.g., "ctrl+shift", "cmd+alt"). Optional.

action_summary.description: A few words saying what this action does on the page and to what, for example 'Sends the drafted reply to pat@example.com' or 'Opens the Filters menu'. Set it on every left_click, right_click, double_click, triple_click, left_click_drag, key and type action. State the effect only, and accurately: no reasons, nothing about what you were asked or allowed to do, no passwords or other secrets.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__resize_window
tools.description: Emulate a viewport size in the Browser pane tab. Presets: mobile (375x812), tablet (768x1024), or desktop, which clears the size emulation and returns the tab to the pane's own responsive size. Custom sizes need both width and height. An emulated size applies to that tab across reloads and navigation (scaled down to fit when it is larger than the pane): reset it with preset "desktop" as soon as you finish testing. The desktop app may also clear a size you set when your turn ends, so set it again in a later turn if you still need it. A size the user picked from the pane's own Viewport menu is theirs and stays until they or you change it; leave it unless they ask. colorScheme (light/dark) emulates prefers-color-scheme on that tab; it survives reloads and preset "desktop" does not touch it, but the pane re-syncs the tab to the app's light/dark theme when that theme changes or the pane reopens; local documents and static HTML previews always render light. The mobile preset (and any width < 768) also emulates a mobile device: Android Chrome user agent and 5 touch points, so pages detect a touch phone; your clicks still arrive as mouse clicks. Reload the page after switching so load-time device gates re-run.

action.description: What to do. Do not skip the early attach because 'launch' also attaches — the panel should be open before the build starts. Skip it only when the user has no interest in watching; 'launch' installs and launches an .app (it also re-attaches, but call 'attach' early rather than relying on that); 'screenshot' returns a PNG of the current screen; 'tap'/'swipe'/'text'/'button' inject input; 'press_key' presses a hardware key 'count' times: return, delete (backspace), an arrow, select_all, undo or redo (a key also hides the on-screen keyboard); 'set_appearance' switches the device to light or dark mode; 'appearance' says which it is in; 'set_keyboard' shows or hides the on-screen keyboard (it appears only while a text field has focus, and 'press_key' and 'text' hide it again); 'rotate' turns the device a quarter turn left or right ('direction'); take a 'screenshot' after it and tap in that screenshot's frame, however it comes back; 'touch_path' performs a single-finger drag along an arbitrary path (eased curves, long-press-then-drag); 'touch2_path' is the two-finger variant for pinch/rotate; 'open_url' opens a deep link; 'detach' closes the panel/stream. NOTE: a 'swipe' or 'touch_path' whose start point is on-screen and within 4pt of an edge performs the OS edge gesture instead of a plain drag — left=back, top=notification shade, bottom=home/app-switcher, right=Control Center (mapped to the current interface orientation). 1	# MM-03.3 v0.2, jalon 1, passe 8 : forme des destinations, initialisation par les seules écritures, bilan de clôture (rapport d'exploration v0.1, passe 8)
2	
3	Branche `formal/access_model_0.1`, à la suite de la passe 7 (dernier commit de passe 7 : `d01fc23`). Module `formal/Ern/MM03.lean`, espace de noms `Ern.MM03`. `formal/Ern/MM02.lean` est inchangé : `git diff d01fc23 -- formal/Ern/MM02.lean` est vide.
4	
5	Sources :
6	- MM-03.3 v0.2 (`ERN_Memory_Model_0.3.3.md`, hors dépôt) ;
7	- les arbitrages A1 à A11, B1 à B10, C1 à C9, D1 à D4, F1 à F7 et G1 à G5, en vigueur sauf ce que J1 remplace ;
8	- les arbitrages J1 et J2 de cette tâche, qui font foi.
9	
10	Le rapport de passe 7 est `formal/reports/MM03_v0.1_p7.md`. Ses décisions et questions sont citées sous la forme « passe 7, (c) n ».
11	
12	## État de la vérification
13	
14	| Contrôle | Résultat |
15	|---|---|
16	| `lake build` | réussit, sans avertissement |
17	| `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom`, `native_decide`, `noncomputable` | aucun dans `formal/` |
18	| `#print axioms` sur les 605 théorèmes | au plus `propext` et `Quot.sound` : 492 utilisent les deux, 104 `propext` seul, 9 aucun ; `Classical.choice` n'apparaît nulle part |
19	| `example` | 358, tous vérifiés par le build : sur les 364 de la passe 7, 342 inchangés et 22 retirés ; 16 ajoutés ((p)) |
20	
21	## Résultats principaux
22	
23	1. **Forme des destinations de `transfer` (J1).**
24	   - `TransferPre` reçoit la clause `SameShape` : la destination a la forme de la source (isomorphisme d'arbres, enfants appariés dans l'ordre des indices, (c) 1).
25	   - La correspondance des parties est `corr`. L'effet déplace chaque autorité détenue par une partie de la source, et chaque emplacement qu'elle possède, vers la partie correspondante de la destination (`mvTo`, `transfer_to_corresponding_parts`). La racine suit l'emplacement possédé (`transfer_rootHeld`, inchangé).
26	   - L'invariant des états atteints `WF3 ∧ Inv3 ∧ AnchorOrderHeld ∧ NoOrphan ∧ ArenaInv` reste démontré (`reachable_access_invariant_ext`, texte inchangé).
27	2. **`issue`, `reset`, `newArena` (J1).** La destination d'un `issue` est une feuille non `Init` qui ne détient aucune autorité active, et elle seule passe à `Init`. `issue` et `reset` n'écrivent plus la valeur arène. `newArena` exige toutes les feuilles du détenteur de `internal` `Init` (`LeavesInit`).
28	3. **Initialisation par les seules écritures (J1).** `init_only_by_writes` : dans tout pas `ok`, une feuille qui passe à `Init` est écrite par ce pas (`write3`, `writeShared`, `store` ou `issue` vers elle), ou est la feuille de la destination d'un `transfer` qui correspond à une feuille `Init` de la source. `init_statics` : sur `S3.init`, seules les feuilles statiques déclarées `Init` le sont.
29	4. **Cas.** Les trois témoins de la passe 7 de feuilles rendues `Init` sans écriture sont rejetés ; chacun a son jumeau `ok` suivi d'une lecture `ok`. Les cas demandés (autorité stockée dans un champ, stockage possédé, transfert champ par champ) donnent les verdicts attendus ((g)).
30	5. **Deux questions nouvelles ((e)).**
31	   - L'isomorphisme ordonné rejette des transferts que l'isomorphisme non ordonné accepterait, et l'isomorphisme non ordonné ne fixe pas de correspondance unique.

which the current frame has exercisable `Modify` (`HasRight`, B2). -/
def HolderRight (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .frame f => f = s.top
  | .place p => HasRight s .modify p

instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderRight s h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold HolderRight <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `release` (MM-03.3 §3, O3), in order: 1 active authority; 2 no active
descendant; 3 no usable place has `a` as anchor, except the place that holds `a`, whose anchor
`a` is removed by the release (F4); C4: the authority is derived, an authority
without origin is rejected, and its holder is the current frame or a place on which the current
frame has exercisable `Modify` (`HolderRight`). O3.4 (guarantees of associated abstractions) is
not represented in the kernel. -/
def ReleasePre (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Active a ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∈ s.D q → (s.A[a]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place q)) ∧
  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none ∧ HolderRight s y.holder) False

instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (ReleasePre s a) := by unfold ReleasePre; infer_instance

/-- `release` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O3). -/
def ReleaseStep (a : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (ReleasePre s a) (releaseEff s a)

/-! ## O4 `transfer` (MM-03.3 §3, A4, A5) -/

/-! ## Shape of a value (J1) -/

/-- Children of the place `x` (MM-03.3.2), in index order. -/
def kids (P : List Place) (x : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range P.length).filter fun r => decide (parentOf P r = some x)

/-- Position of `r` in a list (its length if absent). -/
def posIn (r : Nat) : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | a :: l => if a = r then 0 else posIn r l + 1

/-- The part of `dst` that corresponds to the part `r` of `src` (J1), searched within `n` steps:
`dst` for `src`; for another part, the child, at the same position among the children ordered by
index, of the place that corresponds to its parent. -/
def corrF (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Option Nat
  | 0, r => if r = src then some dst else none
  | n + 1, r => if r = src then some dst else
      match parentOf P r with
      | some p => if p < r then
          (corrF P src dst n p).bind fun p' => (kids P p')[posIn r (kids P p)]? else none
      | none => none

/-- The part of `dst` that corresponds to the part `r` of `src` (J1). -/
def corr (P : List Place) (src dst r : Nat) : Option Nat := corrF P src dst r r

/-- J1, « `dst` a la même forme que `src` (sous-arbres isomorphes) »: every part of `src` has a
corresponding part of `dst` with as many children, and every part of `dst` corresponds to a part
of `src`. Children are matched in index order (ordered isomorphism). -/
def SameShape (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ r ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P r src →
    OptP (corr P src dst r) (fun r' => (kids P r').length = (kids P r).length) False) ∧
  ∀ z ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P z dst →
    ∃ r ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P r src ∧ corr P src dst r = some z

instance (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (SameShape P src dst) := by
  unfold SameShape; infer_instance

/-- Holder within the value at `q` (A4): a place that is `q` or one of its parts. -/
def heldIn (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : Holder → Prop
  | .place r => partOf P r q
  | .frame _ => False

instance (P : List Place) (q : Nat) (h : Holder) : Decidable (heldIn P q h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold heldIn <;> infer_instance

/-- The holder `h` after the transfer of `src` to `dst` (J1): a place, part of `src`, becomes the
corresponding part of `dst` (`corr`, `dst` itself for `src`). Applied to the holders within the
value only. -/
def mvTo (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Holder → Holder
  | .place r => .place ((corr P src dst r).getD dst)
  | .frame f => .frame f

/-- Effect of `transfer(source, destination)` (MM-03.3 §3, O4; A4; A5; J1): every leaf of the
destination becomes `Init`, every leaf of the source `Moved`; the anchors of the source, inherited
ones included, join those of the destination and leave the source and its parts; every authority
held by a part of the source (the source included) is now held by the corresponding part of the
destination (A4, J1); every place owned by a part of the source is now owned by the corresponding
part of the destination, without moving, and its root follows (A5, J1, `RootHeld`). -/
def transferEff (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with
    P := s.P.map fun pl =>
      if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then { pl with owner := mvTo s.P src dst pl.owner } else pl
    I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P dst then .init
      else if l ∈ footprint s.P src then .moved else s.I l
    D := fun q => if q = dst then s.D dst ++ depsOf s src
      else if partOf s.P q src then [] else s.D q
    A := s.A.map fun y =>
      if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y }

/-- Active derived access covering a leaf of the source and not moved with it
(MM-03.3 §3, O4.4; A4). -/
def ActiveDerivedOutside (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ ¬ heldIn s.P src y.holder ∧
    ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P src) False

instance (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Decidable (ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) := by
  unfold ActiveDerivedOutside; infer_instance

/-- Place `q` is owned by `src` or one of its parts, directly or through other owned places,
searched within `k` steps (A5). -/
def ownedWithinF (s : S3) (src : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Bool
  | 0, _ => false
  | k + 1, q =>
    match s.P[q]? with
    | some pl =>
      match pl.owner with
      | .place o => decide (partOf s.P o src) || ownedWithinF s src k o
      | .frame _ => false
    | none => false

/-- Place `q` is owned, transitively, by the value at `src` (A5): its frame changes with the
value when `src` is transferred. -/
def OwnedWithin (s : S3) (src q : Nat) : Prop := ownedWithinF s src (s.P.length + 1) q = true

funext i; simp only [parentOf, transfer_P_get]
  cases s.P[i]? with
  | none => rfl
  | some pl => simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some]; split <;> rfl

theorem transfer_footprint (s : S3) (src dst q : Nat) :
    footprint (transferEff s src dst).P q = footprint s.P q :=
  footprint_congr (transfer_len s src dst) (transfer_parentOf s src dst) q

theorem transfer_partOf (s : S3) (src dst r q : Nat) :
    partOf (transferEff s src dst).P r q ↔ partOf s.P r q := by
  simp only [partOf, transfer_parentOf, transfer_len]

theorem mem_kids {P : List Place} {x r : Nat} :
    r ∈ kids P x ↔ r < P.length ∧ parentOf P r = some x := by
  simp [kids, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range]

theorem kids_nil_iff {P : List Place} {l : Nat} : kids P l = [] ↔ isLeaf P l := by
  constructor
  · intro h r hr hp
    have : r ∈ kids P l := mem_kids.2 ⟨hr, hp⟩
    rw [h] at this; simp at this
  · intro h
    exact nil_of_forall_not_mem fun r hr => by
      obtain ⟨hr, hp⟩ := mem_kids.1 hr; exact h r hr hp

theorem corrF_fuel (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) :
    ∀ n m r, r ≤ n → r ≤ m → corrF P src dst n r = corrF P src dst m r
  | 0, 0, _, _, _ => rfl
  | 0, m + 1, r, h, _ => by
    obtain rfl : r = 0 := by omega
    simp only [corrF]; split
    · rfl
    · split
      · split
        · omega
        · rfl
      · rfl
  | n + 1, 0, r, _, h => by
    obtain rfl : r = 0 := by omega
    simp only [corrF]; split
    · rfl
    · split
      · split
        · omega
        · rfl
      · rfl
  | n + 1, m + 1, r, h₁, h₂ => by
    simp only [corrF]; split
    · rfl
    · split
      · split
        · rw [corrF_fuel P src dst n m _ (by omega) (by omega)]
        · rfl
      · rfl

theorem corr_src (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : corr P src dst src = some dst := by
  unfold corr; cases src <;> simp [corrF]

theorem corr_step {P : List Place} {src dst r p : Nat} (hr : r ≠ src)
    (hp : parentOf P r = some p) (hlt : p < r) :
    corr P src dst r = (corr P src dst p).bind fun p' => (kids P p')[posIn r (kids P p)]? := by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, r = n + 1 := ⟨r - 1, by omega⟩
  unfold corr
  simp only [corrF, hr, ↓reduceIte, hp, hlt]
  rw [corrF_fuel P src dst n p _ (by omega) (Nat.le_refl p)]

theorem getElem?_mem {l : List Nat} {i x : Nat} (h : l[i]? = some x) : x ∈ l :=
  List.mem_of_getElem? h

/-- The place corresponding to a part of `src` is a part of `dst` (J1). -/
theorem corr_partOf {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {src dst : Nat} (hd : dst < s.P.length) :
    ∀ n r r', r < n → corr s.P src dst r = some r' → partOf s.P r' dst
  | 0, _, _, h, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, r, r', hr, h => by
    by_cases e : r = src
    · subst e; rw [corr_src] at h; cases h; exact ⟨hd, .inl rfl⟩
    cases hp : parentOf s.P r with
    | none =>
      unfold corr at h
      cases r with
      | zero => simp [corrF, e] at h
      | succ m => simp [corrF, e, hp] at h
    | some p =>
      have hlt := (hw.parent_lt hp).1
      rw [corr_step e hp hlt] at h
      cases hc : corr s.P src dst p with
      | none => rw [hc] at h; cases h
      | some p' =>
        rw [hc] at h; simp only [Option.bind_some] at h
        have ih := corr_partOf hw hd n p p' (by omega) hc
        obtain ⟨hr'l, hr'p⟩ := mem_kids.1 (getElem?_mem h)
        have hlt' := (hw.parent_lt hr'p).1
        refine ⟨hr'l, .inr ?_⟩
        rw [chain_cons hr'p hlt']
        rcases ih.2 with rfl | hc'
        · exact List.mem_cons_self ..
        · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hc'

/-- A holder within the source moves to a part of the destination (J1, A4, A5). -/
theorem mvTo_part {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {src dst : Nat} (hd : dst < s.P.length) {h : Holder}
    (hh : heldIn s.P src h) : ∃ r', mvTo s.P src dst h = .place r' ∧ partOf s.P r' dst := by
  cases h with
  | frame f => exact hh.elim
  | place r =>
    cases hc : corr s.P src dst r with
    | none => exact ⟨dst, by simp [mvTo, hc], hd, .inl rfl⟩
    | some r' =>
      exact ⟨r', by simp [mvTo, hc], corr_partOf hw hd (r + 1) r r' (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hc⟩

theorem mvTo_place {P : List Place} {src dst : Nat} {h : Holder} (hh : heldIn P src h) :
    ∃ r', mvTo P src dst h = .place r' := by
  cases h with
  | frame _ => exact hh.elim
  | place r => exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

/-- Places with the same owner have the same frame (A5). -/
theorem pframe_eq_of_owner {s : S3} {q r : Nat} {pq pr : Place} (hq : s.P[q]? = some pq)
    (hr : s.P[r]? = some pr) (h : pr.owner = pq.owner) : s.pframe r = s.pframe q := by
  simp only [S3.pframe, pframeF, hq, hr, h]

/-- In the arrival state of a transfer, a part of the destination has the owner of the
destination (A5, J1): their owners were equal before (`WF3`) and change under the same rule. -/
theorem transfer_owner_part {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {src dst r' : Nat} (hr' : partOf s.P r' dst) :
    ∃ pd pr, (transferEff s src dst).P[dst]? = some pd ∧ (transferEff s src dst).P[r']? = some pr ∧
      pr.owner = pd.owner := by
  obtain ⟨pl, pd, hpl, hpd, ho⟩ := hw.ownerOf hr'
  refine ⟨_, _, by rw [transfer_P_get, hpd]; rfl, by rw [transfer_P_get, hpl]; rfl, ?_⟩
  show (if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then _ else pl).owner = (if heldIn s.P src pd.owner then _ else pd).owner
  rw [ho]; split
  · rfl
  · exact ho

/-- A part of the destination is usable after the transfer when the destination is (A5, J1). -/
theorem transfer_usable_part {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {src dst r' : Nat} (hr' : partOf s.P r' dst)
    (hd' : (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst) : (transferEff s src dst).Usable r' := by
  obtain ⟨pd, pr, hpd, hpr, ho⟩ := transfer_owner_part (src := src) hw hr'
  exact hd'.of_same hpd hpr ho (by show s.dead r' = s.dead dst; exact hw.deadOf hr')

/-- A part of the destination has the frame of the destination after the transfer (A5, J1). -/
theorem transfer_pframe_part {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {src dst r' : Nat} (hr' : partOf s.P r' dst) :
    (transferEff s src dst).pframe r' = (transferEff s src dst).pframe dst := by
  obtain ⟨pd, pr, hpd, hpr, ho⟩ := transfer_owner_part (src := src) hw hr'
  exact pframe_eq_of_owner hpd hpr ho

/-- `transfer` changes no skeleton: it creates and duplicates no authority (O4.3). -/
theorem transfer_skel (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : SameSkel s (transferEff s src dst) := by
  refine ⟨by simp [transferEff], fun j => ?_⟩
  rw [transfer_A_get]
  cases s.A[j]? with
  | none => rfl
  | some y => simp only [Option.map_some]; split <;> rfl

/-- A place usable after the transfer was usable before (A5). -/
theorem transfer_usable_back {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s) (hsrc : s.Usable src) {q : Nat}
    (h : (transferEff s src dst).Usable q) : s.Usable q := by
  induction h with
  | @frame q f pl hpl hd ho hf =>
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hpl
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hpl; cases hpl

/-! ## Reachability (MM-03.3 §10) -/

/-- States reached from the initial state with the static storage `statics` (D1) by `ok`
transitions of the kernel operations, of the arena operations `newArena`, `issue` and `reset`
(D3), and of `store` (F4), for fixed contracts `k` (MM-03.3.8). The static storage is well-formed (`ShapeOK`, C6). -/
inductive Reachable (k : K) (statics : Statics) : S3 → Prop where
  | init : ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1)) → Reachable k statics (S3.init statics)
  | derive {s s' : S3} {src q : Nat} {m : Mode} :
      Reachable k statics s → DeriveStep src q m s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | split {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)} :
      Reachable k statics s → SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | release {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} : Reachable k statics s → ReleaseStep a s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | transfer {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | depend {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} : Reachable k statics s → DependStep q x s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | enter {s s' : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} :
      Reachable k statics s → EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | exit {s s' : S3} : Reachable k statics s → ExitStep k s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | read {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → Read3Step a ls s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | write {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → Write3Step a ls s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | writeShared {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :

  | pin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : Reachable k statics s → PinStep p s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'

theorem reachable_access_invariant_ext {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {s : S3}

/-- One step of `Reachable` (MM-03.3 §10; D3; F4): a kernel step or an arena step. -/

  | newArena {s s' : S3} {st i : Nat} : NewArenaStep st i s (.ok s') → Step k s s'
  | issue {s s' : S3} {i via dst : Nat} {region : List Nat} :
      IssueAt k i via region dst s (.ok s') → Step k s s'
  | reset {s s' : S3} {i via : Nat} : ResetAtStep k i via s (.ok s') → Step k s s'

/-- J1: the step from `s` to `s'` writes the leaf `l`: a `write3` or a `writeShared` of a list
containing `l`, a `store` into `l`, an `issue` to `l`, or a `transfer` of which `l` is a leaf of the
destination corresponding to a leaf of the source `Init` before the step. -/
def WrittenBy (k : K) (s s' : S3) (l : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∃ a ls, Write3Step a ls s (.ok s') ∧ l ∈ ls) ∨
  (∃ a ls, WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s') ∧ l ∈ ls) ∨
  (∃ a, StoreStep a l s (.ok s')) ∨
  (∃ i via region, IssueAt k i via region l s (.ok s')) ∨
  (∃ src dst l', TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') ∧ l ∈ footprint s.P dst ∧

`Init` after is written by the step (`WrittenBy`). -/
theorem init_only_by_writes {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : Step k s s') {l : Nat}

    | split hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact absurd hl' hl

      obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs

        rw [hc] at h1

          exact List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (by simp only [OptP] at h1; omega)
        have hrf : r ∈ footprint s.P src :=
          mem_footprint.2 ⟨List.mem_range.1 hr, kids_nil_iff.1 hkr, hrs⟩
        exact .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr ⟨src, dst, r, hs', hld, hrf, hc, hpre.2.1 r hrf⟩)))
      · split at hl'
        · cases hl'
        · exact absurd hl' hl
    | depend hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact absurd hl' hl
    | enter hs =>
      obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
      simp only [enterEff] at hl'; split at hl'
      · cases hl'
      · exact absurd hl' hl
    | exit hs =>
      obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
      unfold exitEff at hl'; split at hl' <;> exact absurd hl' hl
    | read hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact absurd hl' hl
    | write hs =>
      rename_i a ls
      have hs' := hs
      obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
      simp only [write3Eff] at hl'; split at hl'
      · exact .inl ⟨a, ls, hs', ‹_›⟩
      · exact absurd hl' hl
    | writeShared hs =>
      rename_i a ls
      have hs' := hs
      obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
      simp only [write3Eff] at hl'; split at hl'
      · exact .inr (.inl ⟨a, ls, hs', ‹_›⟩)
      · exact absurd hl' hl
    | pin hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact absurd hl' hl
    | unpin hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact absurd hl' hl
    | endUse hs =>
      obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
      simp only [endUseEff, cleanup, endUseS] at hl'; split at hl'
      · cases hl'
      · exact absurd hl' hl
    | free hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact absurd hl' hl
    | alloc hs =>
      cases hs with
      | ok hsa _ =>
        simp only [allocEff] at hl'; split at hl'
        · cases hl'
        · split at hl'
          · exact absurd (hsa.2.2.2.2.1 l ‹_›) hl
          · exact absurd hl' hl
    | store hs =>
      rename_i a p
      have hs' := hs
      obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
      obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := store_pre_auth hpre.1
      rw [storeEff_eq hy] at hl'; simp only at hl'; split at hl'

  | issue hs =>
    rename_i i via dst region

    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    unfold resetAtEff at hl'; split at hl' <;> exact absurd hl' hl

/-- `init_statics` (J1; D1): in the initial state, a leaf is `Init` exactly when it is a static
element declared `Init`. -/
theorem init_statics (statics : Statics) (l : Nat) :
    (S3.init statics).I l = .init ↔ ∃ e, statics[l]? = some e ∧ e.2 = true := by
  simp only [S3.init]
  cases h : statics[l]? with
  | none => simp
  | some e => cases he : e.2 <;> simp [he]

/-- `exitFrame_no_dangling` on reached states (MM-03.3 §4, O7; §10), under `DDSound k`
(MM-03.3.8). -/
theorem exitFrame_no_dangling_reachable {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {s s' : S3} {f : Nat}
    {F₀ : Frames} (hs : Reachable k statics s) (hF : s.F = f :: F₀) (h : ExitStep k s (.ok s')) :
    ∀ q, OwnedByFrame s.P f q → ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s'.A[j]? = some y →
      y.active = true → ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∉ y.footprint :=
  exitFrame_no_dangling (reachable_access_invariant_underDD hdd hs).1 hF h

/-- One `ok` transition of a kernel operation (MM-03.3 §3–5; A6–A9; F4). -/
inductive KStep (k : K) : S3 → S3 → Prop where
  | derive {s s' : S3} {src q : Nat} {m : Mode} : DeriveStep src q m s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | split {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)} :
      SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | release {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} : ReleaseStep a s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | transfer {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | depend {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} : DependStep q x s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | enter {s s' : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} :
      EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | exit {s s' : S3} : ExitStep k s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | read {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Read3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | write {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Write3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | writeShared {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
      WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | pin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : PinStep p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | unpin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : UnpinStep k p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | endUse {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : EndUseStep k p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | free {s s' : S3} {p auth : Nat} : FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | alloc {s s' : S3} {pr ow : Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} :
      AllocStep k pr ow ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | store {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} : StoreStep a p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'

/-- Sufficient conditions for the arena invariant to carry over to a new state: existing
authorities keep mode and footprint, only lose activity, keep an origin equal to `internal`; places
are not removed; `internal` stays held by a place (F1). -/
theorem arenaInv_transport {s s' : S3} {ar : Arena} (hai : ArenaInv s ar)
    (hA : ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[j]? = some y → ∃ y', s'.A[j]? = some y' ∧
      y'.mode = y.mode ∧ y'.footprint = y.footprint ∧ (y'.active = true → y.active = true) ∧
      (y.origin = some ar.internal → y'.origin = some ar.internal))
    (hlen : s.P.length ≤ s'.P.length)
    (hown : ∀ (y y' : Authority) (v : Nat), s.A[ar.internal]? = some y →
      s'.A[ar.internal]? = some y' → y.holder = .place v → ∃ v', y'.holder = .place v')
    (hfoot : ∀ l, l ∈ footprint s'.P ar.storage ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P ar.storage) :
    ArenaInv s' ar := by
  obtain ⟨c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, ⟨yi, vi, hyi, hmi, hhi⟩, c7⟩ := hai
  obtain ⟨yi', hyi', mi, fi, -, -⟩ := hA _ yi hyi
  have hafp : s'.afp ar.internal = s.afp ar.internal := by simp [S3.afp, hyi, hyi', fi]
  have act : ∀ x, s'.Active x → x < s.A.length → s.Active x := fun x ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩ hx => by
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y, s.A[x]? = some y := ⟨_, List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.2 ⟨hx, rfl⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨y'', hy'', -, -, ha, -⟩ := hA x y hy
    rw [hy'] at hy''; cases hy''; exact ⟨y, hy, ha ya'⟩
  have old : ∀ e ∈ ar.issued, e.2 < s.A.length := fun e he => by
    obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := c4 e he; exact lt_of_getElem? hy
  obtain ⟨vi', hh'⟩ := hown yi yi' vi hyi hyi' hhi
  refine ⟨fun l hl => hafp ▸ c0 l hl, fun e he l hl => hafp ▸ c1 e he l hl,
----
      Reachable k statics s → IssueAt k i via region dst s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | reset {s s' : S3} {i via : Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → ResetAtStep k i via s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | store {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → StoreStep a p s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'

/-- Invariants of the reached states (MM-03.3 §10; B8, C1, C2, D3): `WF3`, `Inv3`, arena entries
naming existing authorities (`ArenasWF`) and `ArenaInv` for every live arena. Under `DDSound k`
(MM-03.3.8), used by `split`. -/
theorem reachable_invariants {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {s : S3}
    (h : Reachable k statics s) : WF3 s ∧ Inv3 s ∧ ArenasWF s ∧ ArenasInv s := by
  have mk : ∀ {s s' : S3}, KStep k s s' → WF3 s ∧ Inv3 s ∧ ArenasWF s ∧ ArenasInv s →
      WF3 s' ∧ Inv3base s' → AnchorOrder s' → NoDangling s' →
      WF3 s' ∧ Inv3 s' ∧ ArenasWF s' ∧ ArenasInv s' :=
    fun hk ih h a d => ⟨h.1, ⟨h.2, a, d⟩,
      kstep_preserves_arenas ih.1 ih.2.1.base ih.2.2.1 ih.2.2.2 hk⟩

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) :
    Decidable (MetaRight k s ar via) := by
  unfold MetaRight; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `arena.issue(region)` (MM-03.3 §6; A10; J1): a `Modify` block derived from `internal`
on the region, held by the destination leaf; that leaf, and it only, becomes `Init` (J1, second
bullet), so the initialisation of the arena value is unchanged unless the destination is one of its
leaves (`issue_into_arena_value`; J1, third bullet: a question of the pass-8 report); the region
leaves `available` and joins `issued`. -/
def issueEff (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : S3 × Arena :=
  ({ s.addAuth ⟨.modify, some ar.internal, region, .place dst, true⟩ with
      I := fun l => if l = dst then .init else s.I l },
   { ar with
      available := ar.available.filter fun l => decide (l ∉ region)
      issued := (region, s.A.length) :: ar.issued })

/-- Static preconditions of `arena.issue(region)` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): metadata right (A10); the
region lies in the storage administered by `internal`; the destination `dst` of the block is
usable, exercisable in `Modify` (A2) and holds no initialised value; J1: `dst` is a leaf
(`isLeaf`) that holds no active authority. -/
def IssueStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    Prop :=
  MetaRight k s ar via ∧ s.Active ar.internal ∧ (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal) ∧
  s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧
  isLeaf s.P dst ∧
  ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst)
    True

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat)
    (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (IssueStatic k s ar via region dst) := by
  unfold IssueStatic; infer_instance

/-- The region is available (MM-03.3 §6): otherwise `issue` fails (A10). -/
def Avail (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Prop := ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ ar.available

instance (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (Avail ar region) := by
  unfold Avail; infer_instance

/-- The abstraction has, through `internal`, effective `Modify` on the region (MM-03.3 §6:
the abstraction has the authority needed to distribute the region). The
disjointness from active emissions is removed (A11): it follows from this right
(`issue_disjoint_redundant`). -/
def IssueRight (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ l ∈ region, effective s ar.internal l = some .modify

instance (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (IssueRight s ar region) := by
  unfold IssueRight; infer_instance

/-- Outcomes of `issue` (A10): `ok`, defined failure `fail` with the state unchanged, `reject`
(pass-1 arbitrage 6). -/
inductive IOutcome where
  | ok (s : S3) (ar : Arena)
  | fail (s : S3) (ar : Arena)
  | reject

/-- `arena.issue` as a relation (MM-03.3 §6; A10): `reject` when a static precondition fails;
`fail`, with the state unchanged, when the region is unavailable; `reject` when the region is
available but `internal` lacks the right to distribute it; G4: `reject` when the arrival state,
where the block is held by `dst`, breaks `AnchorOrderHeld`; `ok` otherwise. A failed `issue`
creates no holding relation and has no arrival state, so G4 is not checked before `fail`. -/
inductive IssueStep (k : K) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (s : S3) :
    IOutcome → Prop where
  | ok : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → Avail ar region → IssueRight s ar region →
      AnchorOrderHeld (issueEff s ar region dst).1 →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s
        (.ok (issueEff s ar region dst).1 (issueEff s ar region dst).2)
  | fail : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → ¬ Avail ar region →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.fail s ar)
  | reject : ¬ IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject
  | noRight : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → Avail ar region → ¬ IssueRight s ar region →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject
  | noAnchor : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → Avail ar region → IssueRight s ar region →
      ¬ AnchorOrderHeld (issueEff s ar region dst).1 → IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject

/-- Determinism of `issue` (MM-03.3 §6; A10). -/
theorem issue_det {k : K} {ar : Arena} {via dst : Nat} {region : List Nat} {s : S3}
    {o₁ o₂ : IOutcome} (h₁ : IssueStep k ar via region dst s o₁)
    (h₂ : IssueStep k ar via region dst s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := by
  cases h₁ <;> cases h₂ <;> first | rfl | contradiction

/-- `ok` outcome of `arena.issue` (MM-03.3 §6; A10). -/
theorem issue_ok_iff {k : K} {ar ar' : Arena} {via dst : Nat} {region : List Nat} {s s' : S3} :
    IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.ok s' ar') ↔ IssueStatic k s ar via region dst ∧
      Avail ar region ∧ IssueRight s ar region ∧ AnchorOrderHeld (issueEff s ar region dst).1 ∧
      (s', ar') = issueEff s ar region dst := by
  constructor
  · intro h; cases h with
    | ok h1 h2 h3 h4 => exact ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, e⟩
    have e1 := congrArg Prod.fst e; have e2 := congrArg Prod.snd e
    simp only at e1 e2; subst e1 e2; exact .ok h1 h2 h3 h4

/-- Preconditions of `arena.reset()` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): metadata right; no active authority
derived from `internal`; no usable place anchored on `internal` or on an authority derived from
it. -/
def ResetPre (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) : Prop :=
  MetaRight k s ar via ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ar.internal ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, x ≠ ar.internal ∧ ar.internal ∉ s.ancs x)

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) :
    Decidable (ResetPre k s ar via) := by
  unfold ResetPre; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `arena.reset()` (MM-03.3 §6; A10; J1): the whole storage becomes available, the past
emissions are forgotten; the initialisation of the arena value is unchanged (J1). -/
def resetEff (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : S3 × Arena :=
  (s, { ar with available := s.afp ar.internal, issued := [] })

/-- `arena.reset` as a relation (MM-03.3 §6; A10). -/
def ResetStep (k : K) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 (S3 × Arena) → Prop :=
  Guarded (ResetPre k s ar via) (resetEff s ar)

theorem afp_addAuth_lt {s : S3} {y₀ : Authority} {j : Nat} (h : j < s.A.length) :
    (s.addAuth y₀).afp j = s.afp j := by simp only [S3.afp, addAuth_lt h]

theorem active_addAuth_iff {s : S3} {y₀ : Authority} {x : Nat} (hx : x < s.A.length) :
    (s.addAuth y₀).Active x ↔ s.Active x := by
  simp only [S3.Active, addAuth_lt hx]

/-- The disjointness of a new emission from the active ones follows from the authority of
`internal` (MM-03.3 §6; A11): an active block derived from `internal` covering a leaf takes the
----
  · have := hq.lt; simp [s] at this
  · have := h 0 1 ⟨.modify, none, [0], .frame 0, true⟩ ⟨.modify, none, [0], .frame 1, true⟩ 0

    exact absurd this.1 (by decide)
  · exact absurd (h 0 1 0 .modify .modify (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)).1 (by decide)

/-! ## Arenas in the state (D3) -/

/-- The state with the entry `i` of `arenas` replaced by `ar` (D3). -/
def arenaSet (s : S3) (i : Nat) (ar : Arena) : S3 := { s with arenas := s.arenas.set i ar }

/-- J1: the leaves of the holder `h`, if it is a place, are all `Init`. -/
def LeavesInit (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .place v => ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P v, s.I l = .init
  | .frame _ => True

instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (LeavesInit s h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold LeavesInit <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `newArena storage internal` (D3, F1, F2, J1), in order. Kept from D3: exercisable
`Modify` on `storage`; `storage` usable. F1: `internal`, named by the caller, is active, `Modify`,
exercisable at `Modify` (B2), and held by a place, the arena value; the footprint of `internal` is
the footprint of `storage`; no live arena already has `internal` as `internal`. F1 removes the
guard by place index of D3 and the kind of `internal`; F2 removes the ownership of the storage
(A10): the storage may be a local, a static, an allocated root or a block. J1: the leaves of the
arena value, the holder of `internal`, are all `Init` (`LeavesInit`). -/
def NewArenaPre (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Prop :=
  HasRight s .modify storage ∧ s.Usable storage ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧ y.holder.isPlace = true)
      False ∧
    s.ExercisableAt internal .modify ∧
    (∀ l ∈ s.afp internal, l ∈ footprint s.P storage) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, l ∈ s.afp internal) ∧
    (∀ ar ∈ s.arenas, s.Active ar.internal → ar.internal ≠ internal) ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => LeavesInit s y.holder) True

instance (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Decidable (NewArenaPre s storage internal) := by
  unfold NewArenaPre; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `newArena storage internal` (D3; F1): a new entry, the whole storage available,
nothing issued. -/
def newArenaEff (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with arenas := s.arenas ++ [⟨storage, internal, s.afp internal, []⟩] }

/-- `newArena storage internal : ok | reject` as a relation (D3; F1). -/
def NewArenaStep (storage internal : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (NewArenaPre s storage internal) (newArenaEff s storage internal)

/-- `arena.issue` on the entry `i` of the state (MM-03.3 §6; A10; D3): the step `IssueStep` of the
recorded arena, whose new logical state is written back; a missing entry is rejected. An entry
whose `internal` is released is rejected by `IssueStatic`, which asks it active. -/
inductive IssueAt (k : K) (i via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (s : S3) :
    AOutcome → Prop where
  | ok {ar : Arena} {s' : S3} {ar' : Arena} : s.arenas[i]? = some ar →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.ok s' ar') → IssueAt k i via region dst s (.ok (arenaSet s' i ar'))
  | fail {ar : Arena} {s' : S3} {ar' : Arena} : s.arenas[i]? = some ar →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.fail s' ar') → IssueAt k i via region dst s (.fail s)
  | reject {ar : Arena} : s.arenas[i]? = some ar → IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject →
      IssueAt k i via region dst s .reject
  | none : s.arenas[i]? = none → IssueAt k i via region dst s .reject

/-- Preconditions of `arena.reset()` on the entry `i` of the state (MM-03.3 §6; A10; D3): the entry
exists and is live (an entry whose `internal` is released cannot be reset), and `ResetPre`. -/
def ResetAtPre (k : K) (s : S3) (i via : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.arenas[i]?) (fun ar => s.Active ar.internal ∧ ResetPre k s ar via) False

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (i via : Nat) :
    Decidable (ResetAtPre k s i via) := by
  unfold ResetAtPre; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `arena.reset()` on the entry `i` (D3): `resetEff`, the new logical state written
back. -/
def resetAtEff (s : S3) (i : Nat) : S3 :=
  match s.arenas[i]? with
  | some ar => arenaSet (resetEff s ar).1 i (resetEff s ar).2
  | none => s

/-- `arena.reset` on the entry `i` of the state as a relation (D3). -/
def ResetAtStep (k : K) (i via : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (ResetAtPre k s i via) (resetAtEff s i)

/-- Determinism of `newArena` (D3; F1). -/
theorem newArena_det {st i : Nat} {s : S3} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 S3} (h₁ : NewArenaStep st i s o₁)
    (h₂ : NewArenaStep st i s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := Guarded.det h₁ h₂

/-- Determinism of `arena.reset` on an entry of the state (D3). -/

A chain only follows a link to a strictly smaller index; the fuel `k` only ensures
termination. -/

/-- Strict ancestors of `i` along the link `org`, nearest first. -/
def chainF (org : Nat → Option Nat) : Nat → Nat → List Nat
  | 0, _ => []
  | k + 1, i =>
    match org i with
    | some o => if o < i then o :: chainF org k o else []
    | none => []

/-- Strict ancestors of `i` along `org` (fuel `i`, enough since the chain decreases). -/
def chain (org : Nat → Option Nat) (i : Nat) : List Nat := chainF org i i

theorem chainF_none {org : Nat → Option Nat} {i : Nat} (h : org i = none) :
    ∀ k, chainF org k i = []

/-- `parent` link of the place with index `i` (MM-03.3.2). -/
def parentOf (P : List Place) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (P[i]?).bind (·.parent)

/-- `partOf P p q` (MM-03.3.2, logical composition): `p` is a place of `P` and `q` is `p` itself
or one of its ancestors along `parent`. -/
def partOf (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop :=
  p < P.length ∧ (p = q ∨ q ∈ chain (parentOf P) p)

instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (partOf P p q) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))

/-- Storage leaf (MM-03.3.2): a place without a strict part. -/
def isLeaf (P : List Place) (l : Nat) : Prop := ∀ r < P.length, parentOf P r ≠ some l

instance (P : List Place) (l : Nat) : Decidable (isLeaf P l) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀ _, _))

/-- `footprint P q` (MM-03.3.2): the leaves of `P` that are parts of `q`. -/
def footprint (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range P.length).filter fun l => decide (isLeaf P l ∧ partOf P l q)

/-- Two places overlap when their footprints share a leaf (MM-03.3.2). -/
def overlap (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop := ∃ l ∈ footprint P p, l ∈ footprint P q

instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (overlap P p q) :=
(`EffAnchorOK`); G4: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the arrival state, the whole predicate, for every held
authority; J1: the destination has the shape of the source (`SameShape`). O4.3 holds by
construction. -/
def TransferPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Usable src ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init) ∧
  s.Usable dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s.P src dst ∧
  HasRight s .modify src ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧
  (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ depsOf s src, s.Active x) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src,
    NoEscape (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe dst)) ∧
  (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ (transferEff s src dst).D q,
      (AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor x) ∨ q = dst ∨ OwnedWithin s src q) →
      EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) ∧
  AnchorOrderHeld (transferEff s src dst) ∧ SameShape s.P src dst

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (TransferPre k s src dst) := by
  unfold TransferPre; infer_instance

/-- `transfer` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O4). -/
def TransferStep (k : K) (src dst : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (TransferPre k s src dst) (transferEff s src dst)

/-! ## O5 `depend` (MM-03.3 §3) -/

/-- Effect of `depend(result, anchor)` (MM-03.3 §3, O5): the anchor joins the dependencies of
the result place; existing dependencies are kept; propagation to containing values is computed
by `depsOf`. -/
def dependEff (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with D := fun r => if r = q then s.D q ++ [x] else s.D r }

/-- Preconditions of `depend` (MM-03.3 §3, O5), in order: result place usable (MM-03.3.1);
1 valid anchor; 5 non-escape (MM-03.3.6); B3: exercisable `Modify` on the result; C1: the frame
of the effective anchor is the frame of the result or an ancestor of it (`EffAnchorOK`). O5.2
(real origin of the rights or storage) is not representable: the state does not relate a value
to the origin of its content. O5.3 and O5.4 hold by construction. -/
def DependPre (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Usable q ∧ s.Active x ∧ NoEscape s x (s.pframe q) ∧ HasRight s .modify q ∧
    EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)

instance (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Decidable (DependPre s q x) := by
  unfold DependPre; infer_instance

/-- `depend` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O5). -/
def DependStep (q x : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (DependPre s q x) (dependEff s q x)

/-! ## F4 `store` -/

/-- Effect of `store a p` (F4; G2), the write of a reference into a value: `a` is now held by the
place `p`; `a` joins the anchors of `p`; the leaf `p`, and it only, becomes `Init` (G2). -/
def storeEff (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
  | some y => { s with
      A := s.A.set a { y with holder := .place p }
      D := fun q => if q = p then s.D p ++ [a] else s.D q
      I := fun l => if l = p then .init else s.I l }
  | none => s

/-- Preconditions of `store a p` (F4; G2), in order: `a` active, derived (`a.origin ≠ none`), held
by the current frame; `p` usable; exercisable `Modify` on `p` (B2, `HasRight`); `a` covers no leaf
of `p` nor of its owned storage, transitively (A5, `OwnedIn`); `AnchorOrder` for the added
anchor (C1, `EffAnchorOK`): the frame of the effective anchor of `a` is the frame of `p` or one
of its ancestors. G2: `p` is a leaf, the place of a reference (MM-03.3.2, `isLeaf`); `p` holds no
active authority (overwriting an `Init` leaf without authority is allowed); in the arrival state,
`p` is still exercisable at `Modify` by the current frame (`HasRight`,
`store_keeps_target_reachable`). G4: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the arrival state. No inverse
operation exists (F4). -/
def StorePre (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top) False ∧
  s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
  (∀ l ∈ s.afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P p ∧
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OwnedIn s.P p q → l ∉ footprint s.P q) ∧
  EffAnchorOK s a (s.pframe p) ∧ isLeaf s.P p ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p)
    True) ∧
  HasRight (storeEff s a p) .modify p ∧ AnchorOrderHeld (storeEff s a p)

instance (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Decidable (StorePre s a p) := by unfold StorePre; infer_instance

/-- `store` as a relation (F4). -/
def StoreStep (a p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (StorePre s a p) (storeEff s a p)

/-- Owner of the local of index `i` of `ls` (parent, owning local, kind) in the new frame `f`:
the owning local if any, the new frame otherwise (A5). -/

  obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hx
  have ho' : z.origin = none := by split at ho <;> exact ho
  have hl' : l ∈ z.footprint := by split at hl <;> exact hl
  have hrp' : RootPlace s.P r := by simpa only [RootPlace, transfer_len, transfer_parentOf] using hrp
  have hlr' : partOf s.P l r := (transfer_partOf s src dst l r).1 hlr
  obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hh⟩ := hr x z l r hz ho' hl' hrp' hlr'
  refine ⟨_, by rw [transfer_P_get, hpr]; rfl, ?_⟩

/-- The same without `store` (MM-03.3 §3, O4.2; MM-03.3.3): frame 1 has the leaf 0 and the

  have r2 : Reachable K0 [] it2 := .newArena r1 (show NewArenaStep 5 3 it1 (.ok it2) from

## (c) Décisions non dictées par le texte

Restent en vigueur les décisions des passes 2 à 6, sauf celles que G1 à G4 remplacent :
- passe 6, (c) 5, dernier point (« feuilles de `p` := `Init` » sur toute l'empreinte de `p`) : remplacé par G2 ;
- passe 6, (c) 11 (`store_escape_rejected_at_transfer` sur les ancres) : l'énoncé est gardé sous le nom `anchor_escape_rejected_at_transfer`, et le nom porte l'énoncé sur le détenteur (G4), voir 11 ci-dessous.

G5 confirme les décisions (c) 1 (préconditions de `newArena` gardées de D3) et (c) 4 (`StaticPinnedBottom` sur le cadre de base) de la passe 6, ainsi que la lecture de « nœuds » de F7 (b) ((c) 10, valeurs détentrices des blocs) et la légalité de deux arènes vivantes sur les mêmes feuilles (`y3`). Le module ne change pas pour elles.

Décisions de la passe 7 :

1. **État de la clause G1.** « L'état où le nouveau cadre a reçu ses paramètres » est l'état d'arrivée de `enterFrame`, `enterEff s ps ls`, locaux compris : les paramètres et les locaux sont créés par la même transition. Les racines des locaux ne couvrent que des feuilles nouvelles (`enter_root_fp_ge`).
2. **« À aucun mode »** est `¬ ExercisableAt o .observe ∧ ¬ ExercisableAt o .modify`. « Paramètre de mode `Modify` doté d'une origine » : la clause ne contraint ni les paramètres `Observe`, ni (cas impossible, A3 exigeant une origine) les paramètres sans origine.
3. **`enter_params_protected`.** « L'exclusivité » est lue comme I1 dans l'état d'arrivée (MM-03.3 §2), plus sa conséquence sur chaque paramètre `Modify` : sur ses feuilles, toute autorité de mode effectif présent est le paramètre ou un de ses descendants (`call_params_effective_protected`, appliqué à l'état d'arrivée).
4. **Lecture des clauses de G2.**
   - « `p` est une feuille » est `isLeaf s.P p` ; `p` existe déjà par la clause « `p` utilisable ».
   - « `p` ne détient aucune autorité active » : aucune autorité active de détenteur `.place p`. `p` étant une feuille, être détenu par `p` et être détenu dans `p` coïncident.
   - « Dans l'état d'arrivée, `p` reste `Modify` exerçable par le cadre courant » est une précondition, `HasRight (storeEff s a p) .modify p`, la forme de « `Modify` exerçable » depuis B2. `store_keeps_target_reachable` la réénonce comme conclusion. C'est une précondition et non un théorème des autres clauses : dans `fa7`, `store 8 6` satisfait toutes les autres clauses et échoue sur celle-ci seule (`progress_cycle_whole_nodes`).
5. **Effet de `store` sur `I`.** `storeEff` met `Init` sur la seule feuille `p` (`if l = p`), au lieu de l'empreinte de `p` (passe 6). Pour une feuille, les deux coïncident ; un `store` sur une non-feuille est rejeté.
6. **« Couvre l'emplacement détenteur » (G3)** est lu comme : toute feuille de l'emplacement est dans l'empreinte du maillon (`CoversHolder`). C'est la lecture forte. La lecture « au moins une feuille » s'en déduit, l'empreinte d'un emplacement n'étant jamais vide dans un état bien formé (`exists_mem_footprint`). C'est l'emploi de « couvre » en MM-03.3.5 (« si `a` est inactive ou ne couvre pas `p` »), distinct de l'autorité effective ; la lecture effective rendrait G3 faux ((q)).
7. **Représentation de la chaîne de G3.** Une liste `a₀ :: c` d'autorités, sans répétition (`Nodup`) :
   - `a₀` est active et détenue par un cadre de la pile ;
   - le dernier élément est l'autorité considérée ;
   - deux éléments consécutifs satisfont `CoversHolder` (`Linked`) : le premier est actif et couvre l'emplacement qui détient le second.
8. **Preuve de `NoOrphan` par un invariant auxiliaire.** `NoOrphan` découle de `WF3` et de `RootLive` (`noOrphan_of_rootLive`) : tout emplacement racine utilisable garde une racine active, sans origine, détenue par son propriétaire et d'empreinte celle de l'emplacement. La chaîne suit les racines de la chaîne des propriétaires du détenteur ; `dropLoops` en retire les répétitions. `RootLive` est préservé par chaque opération (`reachable_rootLive`). Ce n'est pas une clause ajoutée à la sémantique : aucune précondition ne le lit.
9. **Contrôle de G4 : prédicat entier dans l'état d'arrivée.** `transfer`, `issue`, `store`, `enterFrame` et `exitFrame` exigent `AnchorOrderHeld` de leur état d'arrivée, pour toutes les autorités détenues et non seulement pour celles dont la relation change : G4 demande que la propriété soit « vérifiée dans l'état d'arrivée ». L'équivalence avec un contrôle des seules relations créées ou déplacées n'est pas prouvée.
10. **`alloc` n'a pas de contrôle G4.** Il crée des relations de détention (la racine de chaque élément racine, détenue par son propriétaire), mais G4 nomme `transfer`, `issue`, `store`, `enterFrame` et la sortie. Ces relations satisfont toujours G4 : une racine est sa propre ancre effective, du cadre de son détenteur (`effAnchorOK_root_held`, `alloc_preserves_anchorOrderHeld`). Aucun verdict ne dépend de ce choix.
11. **`AnchorOrder` étendu.** La clause B8/C1 garde son nom `AnchorOrder` et sa place dans `Inv3` ; l'extension de G4 est `AnchorOrderHeld`. L'invariant des états atteints est étendu par `reachable_access_invariant_ext` (`WF3 ∧ Inv3 ∧ AnchorOrderHeld ∧ NoOrphan ∧ ArenaInv`), sans changer `Inv3`, pour ne restreindre le domaine d'aucun théorème qui suppose `Inv3`.
12. **`store_escape_rejected_at_transfer` sur le détenteur (G4).** L'autorité `a` est active et détenue par la source ou une de ses parties (`heldIn`), son ancre effective ne suit pas la valeur et est du cadre courant `f`, la destination est d'un cadre plus ancien après le transfert. Elle peut avoir été posée par `store`, `issue` ou un `transfer` antérieur. L'énoncé de la passe 6, sur les ancres, reste vrai et est gardé sous le nom `anchor_escape_rejected_at_transfer` : il couvre les ancres posées par `depend`, que la forme sur le détenteur ne couvre pas.
13. **`EnterPreBase`.** Les préconditions de `enterFrame` de la passe 6 portent le nom `EnterPreBase`, et `EnterPre` est `EnterPreBase ∧ G1 ∧ G4`. Les lemmes de `enterFrame` qui n'utilisent que les clauses de la passe 6 supposent `EnterPreBase` ; de même, `store_pre_auth` ne suppose que la première clause de `StorePre`. Sans cela, leur texte inchangé aurait couvert moins de cas (constat 12).
14. **Place du contrôle G4 dans `issue`.** `issue` contrôle G4 après la disponibilité de la région et le droit de `internal` : un rejet `noAnchor` s'ajoute aux issues de `IssueStep`, et `ok` exige `AnchorOrderHeld` de l'état d'arrivée. Une émission sur une région indisponible échoue (`fail`, état inchangé) comme en passe 6 : elle ne crée aucune relation de détention et n'a pas d'état d'arrivée (constat 11, `callee_issue_unavailable_fails`). `IssueStatic` garde son texte de la passe 6.

33:14. **`Satisfiable` (C9).** `K.Satisfiable provider shape s`, lu dans l'état avant `alloc`. Ordre des issues inchangé : `reject` si une précondition statique échoue, sinon `fail` si `Satisfiable` est faux, sinon `ok`. Aucun théorème ne le suppose vrai.
34:15. **`MetaRight` (C6).** Premier disjoint ajouté : `Modify` exerçable sur la valeur arène (`OptP (arenaValue s ar) (HasRight s .modify) False`). `ResetPre` lit le même `MetaRight` depuis la passe 2 : l'alignement vaut aussi pour `reset`.

Sous la clause B8 de C1, son `transfer` est rejeté : `EffAnchorOK` exige que l'ancre effective existe. L'étape 1 l'a donc ré-ancré sur une racine 2 libérée, ajoutée à `A`. Cet état viole `NoDangling` (étape 2). Il reste en `example` sous le nom `xferNd`, avec `¬ NoDangling xferNd`. `transfer_not_inv3_preserving` garde son énoncé de la passe 3 sur un nouveau `xferCex`, qui satisfait l'`Inv3` complet : la source a un lien de parent vers un emplacement d'indice supérieur, que `chain` ignore, si bien qu'elle ne couvre aucune feuille. Le témoin de `alloc_not_inv3_preserving` a ses feuilles `Init`, comme C6 l'exige du fournisseur.

10:1. **Encodage des statiques (D1).** `Statics := List ((Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) × Bool)` : l'encodage des locaux (parent, élément propriétaire, `kind`), plus un drapeau, `true` pour une globale avec initialiseur. D1 n'admet que `Init` et `Uninit` : un booléen exclut `Moved`. Le drapeau est l'état initial d'un élément feuille. Il n'est pas lu pour un élément qui a des parties, dont les feuilles portent leur propre drapeau (MM-03.3.3 : « Les valeurs composites peuvent être partiellement initialisées »).
16:7. **Entrées d'arène (D3).** D3 décrit l'entrée par `{storage, internal}`. L'entrée garde aussi `available` et `issued`, l'état logique de §6, que `reset` modifie (A10 : « `reset` modifie effectivement `available` et `issued` »). Les retirer, en les déduisant des autorités, changerait des verdicts (cas n10 : `issue` sur une arène pleine, `fail`). Une nouvelle entrée a tout son stockage disponible et rien d'émis. Le propriétaire n'est pas un champ : `arenaValue` le lit sur `storage`. Question (e) 5.
20:9. **Préconditions de `newArena`.** Les trois de D3, plus deux :
21:   - le stockage est possédé par un emplacement (A10). Sans cette condition, `newArena` sur la partie d'un local, possédé par un cadre, prendrait pour `internal` une dérivée détenue par ce cadre. `enterFrame` peut la passer en paramètre, et l'invariant tombe alors que l'arène vit (témoin `ow0`). Question (e) 4.
25:    Cette lecture de la sorte n'est pas dictée par le texte, et elle change un verdict : `newArena` sur une partie que n'administre aucune autorité dérivée est rejeté, même quand sa racine la couvre exactement. Témoin `x2` (section « Witnesses of the questions of pass 5 ») :
30:    `newArena 4` était `ok` à `24f23b8`, avec la racine 3 pour `internal`, et il est `reject` depuis `ab04c52`. Question (e) 6.
32:12. **`issue` et `reset` sur une entrée.** `IssueAt k i …` applique `IssueStep` à l'entrée `i` et y réécrit l'état logique ; `fail` laisse l'état inchangé ; une entrée absente est rejetée. Une entrée morte est rejetée par `IssueStatic`, qui exige `internal` active. `ResetAtPre` exige l'entrée vivante, puis `ResetPre`. C'est D3 : « une entrée dont `internal` est libérée … ne peut plus servir à `issue` ni `reset` ».

7:- (c) 8 et 9 : `ArenaInv` et préconditions de `newArena` ;
16:1. **Préconditions de `newArena` gardées de D3.** F1 « remplace la phrase de D3 sur le détenteur de `internal` » et retire la garde par indice. 18:5. **Effet de `store` sur `I`.** `storeEff` met `Init` sur la seule feuille `p` (`if l = p`), au lieu de l'empreinte de `p` (passe 6). Pour une feuille, les deux coïncident ; un `store` sur une non-feuille est rejeté.
25:9. **Contrôle de G4 : prédicat entier dans l'état d'arrivée.** `transfer`, `issue`, `store`, `enterFrame` et `exitFrame` exigent `AnchorOrderHeld` de leur état d'arrivée, pour toutes les autorités détenues et non seulement pour celles dont la relation change : G4 demande que la propriété soit « vérifiée dans l'état d'arrivée ». L'équivalence avec un contrôle des seules relations créées ou déplacées n'est pas prouvée.
26:10. **`alloc` n'a pas de contrôle G4.** Il crée des relations de détention (la racine de chaque élément racine, détenue par son propriétaire), mais G4 nomme `transfer`, `issue`, `store`, `enterFrame` et la sortie. - Rejet : aucun survivant sur la chaîne. Cela couvre « la chaîne atteint la racine d'un emplacement du cadre sortant », et aussi une racine inactive d'un cadre survivant.
    - La chaîne est `ancs` : elle suit `origin` vers des identités strictement décroissantes et s'arrête au premier lien qui ne décroît pas. Elle est donc toujours finie (`reanchor_terminates`). Sous l'ordre des origines de `WF3`, elle atteint une autorité sans origine (`reanchor_reaches_root`). Sans cet ordre, elle peut s'arrêter sur une autorité qui a encore une origine.
13. **`writeShared` (A9).** Le module exige une autorité exerçable et, sur chaque feuille, un mode effectif présent (`Observe` ou `Modify`), une feuille `SharedMutable` et des dépendances valides. L'effet met les feuilles à `Init`, comme `write3`. Les mots « depuis une autorité `Observe` » sont lus comme un minimum : une autorité `Modify` y est aussi admise.
14. **Arène (A10).**
    - La valeur arène est le propriétaire du stockage (`arenaValue`). Les métadonnées sont les feuilles de cette valeur (`metaLeaves`).
    - Le droit sur les métadonnées (`MetaRight`) est un droit `writeShared` : autorité exerçable, mode effectif présent, feuilles `SharedMutable`, dépendances valides.
    - `issue` exige ce droit, `internal` active, la région dans l'empreinte de `internal`, et une destination utilisable, sous `Modify` exerçable, sans feuille `Init`.
    - Issues de `issue` : une région hors de `available` donne `fail` ; une région disponible sur laquelle `internal` n'a pas `Modify` effectif donne `reject` (constructeur `noRight`) ; un échec d'une précondition statique donne `reject`.
    - `issue` n'installe aucune dépendance. A10 : « dépendants ancrés sur le bloc » ; un dépendant s'ancre sur le bloc par `depend`.
    - `reset` met les métadonnées à `Init`, rend toute l'empreinte de `internal` disponible et vide `issued`.
15. **`WF3` (A1).** Clauses, toutes hors du texte de MM-03.3 :
    - les origines précèdent leurs dérivées ;
    - les empreintes sont faites d'emplacements existants ;

/-- With effective coverage, G3 would be false on reached states (G3): in `hu1` and `iu1`,
`NoOrphan` holds but `NoOrphanEff` does not. -/

      Reachable K0 [] iu1 ∧ NoOrphan iu1 ∧ ¬ NoOrphanEff iu1 := by
  obtain ⟨r, -, -, -, -, -, -, hn, -⟩ := held_unexercisable_by_transfer
  obtain ⟨r', -, -, hn', -⟩ := held_unexercisable_by_issue
  exact ⟨r, hn, not_noOrphanEff hu1 [0, 1] (by decide) (by decide) 2

/-- J1: the transfer of a structure whose field holds a stored authority moves that authority to the
corresponding field of the destination. In `fw3`, the view 5 is held by the field 3 of the structure
2; after the transfer of 2 into the structure 4, it is held by the field 5 of 4. -/
theorem transfer_field_authority_follows :
    TransferStep K0 2 4 fw3 (.ok (transferEff fw3 2 4)) ∧ corr fw3.P 2 4 3 = some 5 ∧
      (fw3.A[5]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place 3) ∧
      ((transferEff fw3 2 4).A[5]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place 5) :=

corresponding part of the destination (A5; `RootHeld`). Frame 1: structure 0 with the field 1,
which owns the place 2 (root 1, held by 1); structure 3 with the field 4. The frame writes the field

def ts1 : S3 := transferEff ts0 0 3

    Reachable K0 [] ts1 ∧ TransferStep K0 0 3 ts0 (.ok ts1) ∧
      (ts0.P[2]?).map (·.owner) = some (.place 1) ∧ (ts0.A[1]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place 1) ∧

rejected (the field 2 is not `Init`, O4.1); the transfer of the field 1 into the field 4 is accepted,

    (show Write3Step 0 [1] _ (.ok pf0) from .ok (by decide))) ht, .reject (by decide), by decide,

/-- J1, « sous-arbres isomorphes », read as an ordered isomorphism (`SameShape`: children matched
in index order); a question of the pass-8 report. Frame 1: structure 0 with the leaf 1 and the
structure 2 of fields 3 and 4; structure 5 with the structure 6 of fields 7 and 8, then the leaf 9;
structure 10 with the leaf 11 and the structure 12 of fields 13 and 14. The frame writes the leaves
of 0. The transfer of 0 into 5, isomorphic as unordered trees only, is rejected, by the shape
clause alone; into 10 (twin), accepted. Field by field, 1 into 9 and 2 into 6 have the same
shape. -/
def sq0 : S3 := enter1 [(none, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0), (some 2, none, 0),
  (some 2, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (some 5, none, 0), (some 6, none, 0), (some 6, none, 0),
  (some 5, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (some 10, none, 0), (some 10, none, 0), (some 12, none, 0),
  (some 12, none, 0)]
def sq1 : S3 := write3Eff sq0 [1, 3, 4]
theorem transfer_shape_ordered :
    Reachable K0 [] sq1 ∧ kids sq1.P 0 = [1, 2] ∧ kids sq1.P 5 = [6, 9] ∧
      ¬ SameShape sq1.P 0 5 ∧ TransferStep K0 0 5 sq1 .reject ∧
      (SameShape sq1.P 0 5 → TransferPre K0 sq1 0 5) ∧
      TransferStep K0 0 10 sq1 (.ok (transferEff sq1 0 10)) ∧
      SameShape sq1.P 1 9 ∧ SameShape sq1.P 2 6 := by
  exact ⟨.write (.enter (.init (by decide)) (.ok (by decide)))
    (show Write3Step 0 [1, 3, 4] sq0 (.ok sq1) from .ok (by decide)), by decide, by decide,
    by decide, .reject (by decide), by decide, .ok (by decide), by decide, by decide⟩

/-- J1, bullets 2 and 3: an `issue` to a leaf of the arena value that is not `Init` makes it
`Init`, so the initialisation of the arena value changes (a question of the pass-8 report). Frame 1:
structure 0 with the fields 1 and 2, the arena value; 3 the allocator value; 4 a leaf. `alloc` gives
the storage 5 with the part 6, owned by 0. The frame writes 1 and 2, registers the arena
(`newArena 5 3`), moves the field 1 into 4 (1 becomes `Moved`), then issues `[6]` to 1: accepted,
1 is `Init` again. -/
def iv0 : S3 := enter1 [(none, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0), (none, none, 0),
  (none, none, 0)]
def iv1 : S3 := allocEff (write3Eff iv0 [3]) 3 0 [(none, none, 0), (some 5, none, 0)]
def iv1w : S3 := write3Eff iv1 [1, 2]
def iv2 : S3 := newArenaEff iv1w 5 3
def arIv : Arena := ⟨5, 3, [6], []⟩
def iv3 : S3 := transferEff iv2 1 4
def iv4 : S3 := arenaSet (issueEff iv3 arIv [6] 1).1 0 (issueEff iv3 arIv [6] 1).2
theorem issue_into_arena_value :
    Reachable K0 [] iv4 ∧ arenaValue iv3 arIv = some 0 ∧ 1 ∈ footprint iv3.P 0 ∧
      iv2.I 1 = .init ∧ iv3.I 1 = .moved ∧ IssueAt K0 0 0 [6] 1 iv3 (.ok iv4) ∧ iv4.I 1 = .init := by
  have r0 : Reachable K0 [] iv0 := .enter (.init (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))
  have r1 : Reachable K0 [] iv1 := .alloc (.write r0 (show Write3Step 1 [3] iv0 (.ok _) from
    .ok (by decide))) (show AllocStep K0 3 0 [(none, none, 0), (some 5, none, 0)] _ (.ok iv1) from
      .ok (by decide) trivial)
  have r2 : Reachable K0 [] iv2 := .newArena (.write r1 (show Write3Step 0 [1, 2] iv1 (.ok iv1w) from
    .ok (by decide))) (show NewArenaStep 5 3 iv1w (.ok iv2) from .ok (by decide))
  have r3 : Reachable K0 [] iv3 := .transfer r2 (show TransferStep K0 1 4 iv2 (.ok iv3) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have hi : IssueAt K0 0 0 [6] 1 iv3 (.ok iv4) :=
    .ok (ar := arIv) (by decide) (.ok (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide))
  exact ⟨.issue r3 hi, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, hi, by decide⟩

/-- A child arena whose storage is a block of the parent arena, issued to a leaf distinct from the
arena values (D3; J1), which replaces the nested form rejected by J1 (`nested_same_value_rejected`).
Frame 1: 0 parent arena value, 1 allocator value, 2 child arena value, 3 destination of a child
block; storage 4 with the part 5. The parent (`newArena 4 4`) issues `[5]` to 2; the child
(`newArena 5 5`) issues `[5]` to 3. The parent `reset` is rejected while the child's `internal` is
active, accepted once it is released; the child `issue` is then rejected. -/
def cq0 : S3 := enter1 [(none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (none, none, 0)]
def cq2 : S3 := allocEff (write3Eff cq0 [1]) 1 0 [(none, none, 0), (some 4, none, 0)]
def cq2w : S3 := write3Eff cq2 [0]
def arCq : Arena := ⟨4, 4, [5], []⟩
def cq3 : S3 := newArenaEff cq2w 4 4
def cq4 : S3 := arenaSet (issueEff cq3 arCq [5] 2).1 0 (issueEff cq3 arCq [5] 2).2
def cq5 : S3 := newArenaEff cq4 5 5
def arCq2 : Arena := ⟨5, 5, [5], []⟩
def cq6 : S3 := arenaSet (issueEff cq5 arCq2 [5] 3).1 1 (issueEff cq5 arCq2 [5] 3).2
theorem child_arena_in_block :
    Reachable K0 [] cq6 ∧ cq5.arenas.map (fun ar => (ar.storage, ar.internal)) = [(4, 4), (5, 5)] ∧
      IssueAt K0 1 0 [5] 3 cq5 (.ok cq6) ∧ ResetAtStep K0 0 0 cq5 .reject ∧
      ReleaseStep 5 cq5 (.ok (releaseEff cq5 5)) ∧
      ResetAtStep K0 0 0 (releaseEff cq5 5) (.ok (resetAtEff (releaseEff cq5 5) 0)) ∧
      IssueAt K0 1 0 [5] 3 (releaseEff cq5 5) .reject := by
  have r0 : Reachable K0 [] cq0 := .enter (.init (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))
  have r1 : Reachable K0 [] (write3Eff cq0 [1]) :=
    .write r0 (show Write3Step 1 [1] cq0 (.ok _) from .ok (by decide))
  have r2 : Reachable K0 [] cq2 := .alloc r1
    (show AllocStep K0 1 0 [(none, none, 0), (some 4, none, 0)] _ (.ok cq2) from .ok (by decide) trivial)
  have r3 : Reachable K0 [] cq3 := .newArena (.write r2 (show Write3Step 0 [0] cq2 (.ok cq2w) from
    .ok (by decide))) (show NewArenaStep 4 4 cq2w (.ok cq3) from .ok (by decide))
  have r4 : Reachable K0 [] cq4 := .issue r3 (show IssueAt K0 0 0 [5] 2 cq3 (.ok cq4) from
    .ok (ar := arCq) (by decide) (.ok (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)))
  have r5 : Reachable K0 [] cq5 := .newArena r4 (show NewArenaStep 5 5 cq4 (.ok cq5) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have hi : IssueAt K0 1 0 [5] 3 cq5 (.ok cq6) :=
    .ok (ar := arCq2) (by decide) (.ok (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide))
  exact ⟨.issue r5 hi, by decide, hi, .reject (by decide), .ok (by decide), .ok (by decide),
    .reject (ar := arCq2) (by decide) (.reject (by decide))⟩

  kind : Nat
